notes.title: Ping Profit Demo Update
notes.content:
[h3]🔧 [b]What’s New[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]🧭 Tutorial Toggle[/b]
You can now disable the tutorial and jump straight into the action![/p][/*][*][p][b]⚙️ Performance Optimizations[/b] Smoother gameplay and improved frame rates—especially for lower-spec systems. We know it is not perfect, and more optimizations are on the way![/p][/*][*][p][b]📊 Updated Server Management Types UI[/b]
The UI now aligns with the rest of the game and includes smoother transitions and cleaner interactions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]📐 Grid Placement System[/b]
Racks can now be placed more easily with a new grid system for smoother setup and layout.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618170/d91a6920771fda7895ce59209fa585327ce8fff4.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]💬 A Note From the Team[/h3][p]This demo represents just a [b]small sliver[/b] of the game we’re building. Thank you to everyone who played, shared feedback, and reported bugs through the in-game form (found in the pause menu)![/p][p]Here are a few quick responses to common questions:[/p][list][*][p][b]Is this the full game?[/b]
Not even close! This demo is a limited preview of what we’re working on. Here are some high-level features we’re planning to expand and build toward:[/p][list][*][p]🖥️ More Server Types [/p][/*][*][p]🎮 Mini Games[/p][/*][*][p]🏢 New Levels with Unique Room Types[/p][/*][*][p]🌱 Tech Tree Progression[/p][/*][*][p]👨‍💼 Expanded Employee Management[/p][/*][*][p]📈 Advanced Charts & In-Game Reporting Metrics[/p][/*][*][p]⚡ New Systems: Electrical Rooms, Generators, Switches, and More[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Will there be other languages?[/b]
Yes! Localization is on our roadmap, but we want to finish more core gameplay first.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Will there be more optimizations and improvements?[/b] [/p][p]We’re improving our foundation and stability before expanding core systems. Build Mode is in development—allowing players to fully customize their data center in Free Mode. It’s a critical part of both sandbox and campaign progression.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618170/f3522e7ff0d705a5b6db7648b415a1cf9ab491c4.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🚀 Coming Soon: Early Access[/h3][p]We’re heading toward Early Access and would love your help shaping the journey. Expect regular updates, new content, and plenty of ways to get involved![/p][p]📌 [b]Wishlist & Follow us on Steam[/b]:
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3605560/Ping_Profit__Internet_Tycoon/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Ping Profit Demo Update
notes.content:
[h3]🔧 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Tutorial Updates[/b] – Smoother hand motions and clearer instructional messages.
[*][b]Electric Panel Bug[/b] – Fixed disappearing menu; panel is now properly upgradeable.
[*][b]AC Menu Fix[/b] – Menu now opens reliably and accepts input as expected.
[*][b]Selling Window Exploit[/b] – You can no longer sell your window for profit (you cheeky tycoons); upgrades only!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618170/4f59b2c3286cc9d66174035dc2d3668fdb94f847.png[/img]
[*][b]Rack Placement Goals[/b] – The rack goal should now only trigger once instead of twice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618170/b7297d3262aa90c3bf03ed6276cbd6cb92d515cd.png[/img]
[*][b]Volume Control[/b] – You can now adjust volume with arrow keys, and the slider is much smoother.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618170/ff0bf5d4c3f92754cf649c6330b0a29c92ca293d.png[/img]
[/list]

[h3]💡 Environment Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Game Balance Tweaks[/b] – Adjusted breakage logic, heat scaling, and amperage balance for smoother gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618170/67dc38629c1ce59821b9cec54ade49bbd79e77bd.png[/img]  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618170/68e779f180d4b2e306706494dbfc6a0dcedadf40.png[/img]  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618170/1cb7f030c460fb264a59ef8e45765a5946f14b3f.png[/img]
[*][b]Lighting[/b] – Improved lighting in the basement to enhance clarity and mood.
[*][b]Shadows[/b] – More accurate rack shadows for better spatial feedback.
[*][b]Object Highlights[/b] – Enhanced visibility on interactive items. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618170/5c70ed10f3e730eb22340df9652637134d280fcc.png[/img]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618170/010777b32dc240949e947da6b520282f32b2b8d0.png[/img]
[h3]💬 Feedback Spotlight + What’s Ahead
[/h3]Your feedback continues to shape the future of [b]Ping Profit[/b], and we’ve already started evaluating several requested features for the next updates:
[list]
[*][b]Updated Hotkey Integration[/b] – Better keyboard support for fast actions and smoother gameplay.
[*][b]Additional UI Improvements[/b] – Ongoing tweaks to enhance clarity, feedback, and overall visual flow.
[*][b]Togglable Tutorial[/b] – We’re working on giving you the option to turn the tutorial on or off at will.
[*][b]Camera Functionality[/b] – Improved control, smoother movement, and better angle options are on our radar.
[/list]
Some of these will appear in future demo patches, others may roll into the full game — keep that feedback coming!

Thanks for helping shape [i]Ping Profit[/i] into something truly unique. Every comment, bug report, and wishlist helps push us forward.


📌 Don’t forget to wishlist Ping Profit if you haven’t already
